name: Nár Thúathcaech
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nar Thuathcaech is an Irish hero. Shame is an alias for the one people call Friuch. Friuch was an argumentative swineherd reborn into the mighty bull Donn Cuailnge. Queen Medb of Connacht set her sights on that bull. His name may come from his part in the slaughter told in the Tain Bo Cuailnge. His whispers led Medb to marry Ailill mac Mata. Ailill then challenged her to match him, and the cattle raid on Ulster began.
